subject: Rename redis.info to valkey.info in LCOV (#259)
reason: The change only renames the LCOV coverage output file from redis.info to valkey.info in the src/Makefile lcov target and updates src/.gitignore to match. It is a build/CI-only change: no server code, command behaviour, replies, replication, persistence or tooling is affected, so no runtime scenario can reach it and none is needed.
